title: To-Do App Web

title: Excel To Invoice
description: A Python automation tool that reads invoice data from Excel spreadsheets and generates formatted PDF invoices containing invoice details, product information, and calculated totals.

title: PDF Template Generator
description: A Python utility that reads topics and page counts from a CSV file and automatically generates a multi-page A4 PDF template with topic headings, footers, and writing lines.

description: A Python Natural Language Processing project that analyzes a book using word-frequency analysis, stopword removal, and chapter-level sentiment analysis.

title: Webcam Detection

title: News To Email
description: A Python automation project that retrieves recent news articles for a selected topic through NewsAPI, formats the results into an email digest, and sends it through Gmail SMTP.

technologies: Python, Requests, SelectorLib, Web Scraping, SMTP

title: Weather API

technologies: Python, Flask, Pandas, REST API, HTML

title: Weather Data App

technologies: Python, Streamlit, OpenWeatherMap API, Requests, Plotly
